tasks.title: Bind browser adapters and synthetic fixture sources to qualification receipts
tasks.body:
Goal:
Bind current browser assertions and owned synthetic data to qualification receipt identity before relying on final local UI validation.

Current behavior:
The rendered-browser recipe declares the adapter map and shared helpers but omits41of42 directly referenced local journey/data inputs. The installed workflow recipe_for hashes only declared input_paths. A changed unregistered journey or JSON fixture can remain outside profile/check identity. The composer intentionally adds the registry path and static qualification marker; normalization is preserved.

Touch:
- `.skill-tree/validation-recipes.json`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-adapters.json`
- `tests/browser-qualification/source-identity.test.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/source-identity-fixture.py`
- `.skill-tree/documents/testing.md`

Implementation constraints:
Add explicit reviewed repository-relative inputs and retain current pins, execution boundaries, source guards, immutable terminal outcomes and original reports. Do not rewrite completed check definitions or accept a reduced matrix. Temporary mutation controls operate only in disposable directories. No product UI, live account, provider, permission, deployment or publication change is authorized. The owner questions in the release parent remain unresolved.

Validation:
Use failing source-drift controls before registration changes, then actual workflow Green and static profile checks. Refresh and re-admit the installed profile after source registration. Revalidate affected completed UI contracts in the existing run; the final local validation ledger remains required before the release handoff. Missing owner/device evidence cannot become accepted through synthetic checks.

Acceptance:
- Every reviewed local adapter module, local module dependency and declared synthetic fixture input participates in the installed qualification source fingerprint.
- Controlled temporary source/data mutations make the actual installed workflow reject stale profile evidence; unchanged sources remain reusable and refreshed inputs change the environment identity.
- The refreshed profile retains pinned recipes and boundaries, and affected completed local UI contracts receive current-source revalidation without accepting owner-only release gates.
